setting: Lucia, inside Hamlet Correctional, with a flashback to the outside.
summary:
A cold open shows the night Lucia and Jason first meet, both trying to steal the same car. Two years on, Lucia is serving time and talking her way toward supervised release with her counselor, [Stefanie](/gameplay/characters/stefanie).

The flashback shows how she got there: broke, she left her baby son **Tomás** at a café and robbed the payday loan store across the street. She was caught running back for him, and child services took the boy. Getting him back drives everything she does after this, and the release address she gives is Jason's.

title: Just Like Paradise
setting: The [Leonida Keys](/gameplay/locations/leonida-keys). Mostly Jason, working odd jobs while Lucia waits on her release.
summary:
Jason runs errands and dirty work for [Brian Heder](/gameplay/characters/brian-heder) around Key Lento with [Cal](/gameplay/characters/cal-hampton): drops at sea, rent collections, a broker who stops answering, and a growing feud with a swamp crew called the Kingfishers. He already knows Lucia's boy is his when he picks her up from prison. She moves into his house on an ankle monitor and talks her way onto his work.

The jobs get bigger until a pickup at the [Grassrivers](/gameplay/locations/grassrivers) visitor center turns into a police ambush. Jason is badly hurt, the house goes up in flames, and Lucia breaks him out of a Vice City hospital with the law and worse closing in.

By the end the pair are on the run with a bag a lot of people want back, and a police captain, **Aldo Méndez**, has pinned a dead officer on them.

title: Paradise Lost
setting: [Port Gellhorn](/gameplay/locations/port-gellhorn). Mostly Lucia, with Jason back in the action near the end.
summary:
Hiding at the [Starlet Motel](/gameplay/locations/starlet-motel), Lucia keeps them both afloat while Jason heals: rent, painkillers, a car through the mechanic [Moses](/gameplay/characters/moses-watkins), and a small network of her own in town.

Once Jason is on his feet they rob their way to the money they need, including a job set up by [Vicki](/gameplay/characters/vicki), who wants her cut. An ambush at the motel pushes them out, and they leave for [Vice City](/gameplay/locations/vice-city).

title: Tits, Ass, Drug Money
setting: [Vice City](/gameplay/locations/vice-city). Jason and Lucia together, and you can switch between them.
summary:
Jason's old friend [Dre'Quan](/gameplay/characters/dre-quan-priest) finds them a place through [Boobie Ike](/gameplay/characters/boobie-ike), and Jason works off the debt. Lucia reconnects with her mother, [Mia](/gameplay/characters/mia-caminos), whose real estate deal drags her into a fight with a local gang.

[Raul Bautista](/gameplay/characters/raul-bautista) tests the pair and pulls them into his crew. Job by job, the chapter builds to a hit on Sinfrontera National Bank, where a cartel keeps its money.

title: Vice City, Baby
setting: [Vice City](/gameplay/locations/vice-city), from a new base in [Ocean Beach](/gameplay/locations/ocean-beach). Both leads.
summary:
Paid, and set up in an Ocean Beach hotel suite arranged by **Valentina**, the pair still have a lawyer to keep paid. They work security for [Andres de Leon](/gameplay/characters/andres-de-leon) at the [MegaMundo](/gameplay/brands/megamundo) opening, and scout and staff Raul's second big job at the airport.

Then it comes apart. Valentina hands Raul to **Méndez**, and Jason and Lucia find him tortured and dying.

title: Top of the World, Ma
setting: [Vice City](/gameplay/locations/vice-city). Both leads, for the final run.
summary:
Seven missions, one last plan. The bag from the visitor center belonged all along to **Giorgio Gallo**, a shipping magnate, and he takes the pair in with the promise of a pardon. In the end he sells them out.

There is more than one ending. After the credits the game rewinds to the eve of the finale, so you can run it again for another outcome.
